description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the DistributedSub interface, providing methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, and managing acknowledgment labels in a distributed pub/sub system using Akka actors and Akka clustering. It manages communication with a supervisor actor and handles asynchronous responses related to pub/sub subscription management.

classes.name: DistributedSubImpl
classes.description: Final class implementing the DistributedSub interface, managing subscriptions and acknowledgments in a distributed pub/sub system using Akka actors and clustering, with support for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: subscribeWithFilterAndAck
methods.description: Subscribes to topics with a filter predicate and acknowledgment, returning a CompletionStage with the subscription acknowledgment.

methods.name: subscribeWithAck
methods.description: Subscribes non-filtered to topics with acknowledgment, returning a CompletionStage with the subscription acknowledgment.

methods.name: unsubscribeWithAck
methods.description: Unsubscribes from topics with acknowledgment, returning a CompletionStage with the result.

methods.name: askSubSupervisor
methods.description: Sends a request to the supervisor actor and processes the response asynchronously.

methods.name: subscribeWithoutAck
methods.description: Subscribes to topics without acknowledgment, sending a message to the supervisor actor.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes the specified subscriber actor from the subscription system.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgment labels with the supervisor and returns a CompletionStage with the response.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgement label declarations for a subscriber.

methods.name: processAskResponse
methods.description: Processes the response from an ask pattern call, returning a completed or failed CompletionStage.
